info.name: Create any audio content with an AI-generated script

items.docs: Generates audio content from a natural-language prompt with an AI-written script. Returns a job_id.

info.name: Create any audio content with a user-provided script

items.docs: Generates audio from a user-provided script of ordered text/voice_id segments. Returns a job_id.

info.name: Generate AI-scripted podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode

items.docs: Generates a two-host conversational podcast from a prompt. Requires exactly two voice IDs. Returns a job_id.

info.name: Generate podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode and a user-provided script

items.docs: Generates a two-host conversational podcast from a user-provided script. Returns a job_id.

info.name: Get audio content result and status

items.docs: Retrieves job status. When finished, returns the generated script and an MP3 download URL.

info.name: Get podcasts for the authenticated user

items.docs: Returns the podcasts associated with the authenticated API key.
Verifies the supplied API key and returns the associated account email.
